intro.title: Word Search
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that checks if a given word exists in a 2D grid of letters, moving horizontally or vertically. You will learn the core concept of backtracking, a recursive technique for exploring possible paths and undoing choices that don't lead to a solution. The main technologies involved are JavaScript functions, arrays, loops, and recursion. This beginner-friendly project will help you practice problem-solving with grid-based algorithms.
intro.usecase: The Word Search algorithm is a foundational pattern for text processing and search features in real-world applications. Developers implement it in search bars for document editors, enabling users to find specific words or phrases within large text files. It powers the 'Find' functionality in web browsers and code editors, allowing rapid navigation through content. This pattern also underlies features like highlighting matching terms in data tables or filtering lists based on keyword input, making it essential for building efficient, user-friendly search interfaces.
